_note: Formats seen (digits masked). SF Contact.Phone/MobilePhone are free text. Nooks call.to is mostly E.164 but sometimes has spaces. Proposed normaliser: strip everything except digits and a leading '+'; '00' prefix -> '+'; leading '+' keep; digits already starting with the country code (61/64) and >=11 digits -> add '+'; leading '0' -> prefix the country calling code (+61 AU, +64 NZ) taken from the PHONE's own context, falling back to the account country only if nothing else. Never override an explicit '+' prefix with the account country (a +61 mobile exists on an NZ account).
observed_match: SF MobilePhone '+61 409 074 447' == Nooks call.to '+61409074447' after stripping spaces (one verified pair).
